summary: Short kerb at a junction mouth, backing onto a commercial yard.
reasons: Right at the Henderson St corner
Cars park just west of it

best_section.where: Grosvenor Road south kerb at the Henderson Street corner

drivers.seclusion: South side is a commercial yard and car park; nearest apartments 23 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb curves around the junction; a van would sit close to the corner, tight to the turning lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy junction with through traffic on both streets.
drivers.convention: 4P parallel Mon-Sat signs; cars park along the kerb just to the west.

flags: At a junction, may block turns
sun_shade: Open; palms and small trees on the south side give partial afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the corner is legal to stop on
